note: M0 district registry. Each district ships as its own Godot pack next to index.pck (build/web/districts/<id>.pck) and streams in while the player keeps skating. The 'apron' is a plain main-pack floor over the district footprint (with low side and end walls) that stands in until the pack arrives or if it fails, so the wheels never drop. Loading cards live in the main pack so they show before the district arrives. 'free_roam': false means the district only arms with ?district=<id> (web) or the district=<id> user arg; free roam is unchanged.

glass_row_edge.title: GLASS ROW · EDGE
glass_row_edge.note: A1 (approved Nov 18 2026). Act I M3: holds all of MISSION P.2 Run (service alley, loading dock ledge, stair set, parking ramp, plaza with the mister kiosk, the storm drain). Built in world coordinates (origin 0). Armed by the story when P.2 Run starts, or ?district=glass_row_edge. budget_bytes is this pack's own budget, inside the 8 MiB per-district cap.

solar_arcade_dark.title: SOLAR ARCADE
solar_arcade_dark.note: Act I M4: the arcade interior, dark, for MISSION P.3 Power On (fuses, the breaker, the sweep). Off-map east of Glass Row; reached only by the story's fade at the side door. Armed and requested when P.2 Run starts so it is in before the door. Own budget inside the 8 MiB per-district cap.
